# Packages every job installs. One per line; `#` starts a comment.
# Read by install.sh and hashed into the apt cache key, so editing this file
# (or packages-e2e-runtime.txt, or install.sh, or action.yml) starts a fresh
# cache.
#
# libgstreamer*-dev are here so CI can COMPILE-CHECK the ARM client's
# decode backend, which no runner can run. That check was impossible
# with the previous cros-codecs backend -- it did not build off aarch64
# at all -- so this is the gate that replaced "verified by hand on the
# reference machine". Headers only; no GStreamer plugins are installed
# and nothing here executes a pipeline.
#
# libxkbcommon-dev is a hard build-time gate, not a convenience:
# smithay-client-toolkit's build.rs does an unconditional
# `pkg_config::find("xkbcommon").unwrap()` under the `xkbcommon`
# feature, so without it every job that compiles the workspace dies
# in a build script before a single test runs. libxkbcommon-x11-dev
# is needed at link time instead -- the `xkbcommon` crate's `x11`
# feature carries `#[link(name = "xkbcommon-x11")]`, and only the
# -dev package ships the unversioned .so the linker resolves.
build-essential
pkg-config
clang
libclang-dev
libavcodec-dev
libavformat-dev
libavutil-dev
libswscale-dev
libavdevice-dev
libx264-dev
libx11-dev
libxext-dev
libxdamage-dev
libdrm-dev
libxkbcommon-dev
libxkbcommon-x11-dev
libgstreamer1.0-dev
libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev
xvfb
